about.title: About me
about.description: Full Stack Developer with comprehensive mastery of the modern web ecosystem, specialized in JavaScript (ES6+, Node.js, Express, NestJS), Python (Django, FastAPI) and C# (.NET). I design and implement robust architectures with MySQL and MongoDB databases, scalable RESTful APIs, and professional version control (Git/GitHub/GitLab). I combine technical excellence with analytical thinking, proactivity, and an unwavering commitment to code quality and efficient problem-solving.

project1.title: Help Desk — Ticket System
project1.desc: Internal support ticket system with Kanban panel, priority management, agent assignment, and real-time filters. Built with React, Node.js, Express and MySQL.

project2.title: Appointment Scheduling System
project2.desc: Appointment management platform with role-based auth, offline mode with local storage, metrics dashboard, and status tracking. Python FastAPI backend with React frontend.

project3.title: Inventory & Sales System
project3.desc: Comprehensive inventory and billing system with real-time stock control, sales recording, report generation and product management. Full stack with React, Node.js and MySQL.

project4.title: Cybersecurity
project4.desc: Hardening system, intrusion detection and real-time monitoring. Automated vulnerability analysis with Python and Bash scripts. Currently in development.
